title: 第1081章 动荡不安第1080章 强行破界
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
元始与通天化作两道流光掠至界壁边缘时。
恰逢苍云天道完成了最后一击。
轰——！
只听一声响彻三界的轰然巨响，原本还在缓缓蔓延的界膜裂痕，瞬间被一股无可匹敌的力量撑爆。
两界壁垒如碎裂的琉璃般大片崩落。
金色的天道洪流自缺口处倒灌而入，犹如天河溃堤般涌入。
以缺口为中心，苍云界的天道法则以肉眼可见的速度向地星腹地侵染，不过数息之间，便已覆盖了近半的天幕。
周天星斗随之偏移，地星本土三百六十五座主星位被强行挤偏轨迹，地脉龙气发出不堪重负的轰鸣。
四海之水倒卷冲天，山岳在法则碰撞下此起彼伏地隆升坍缩。
动荡并不只发生在两界通道附近。
由于地星天地规则受到冲击。
哪怕不是苍云天道降临之地也同样被动荡波及在内。
苍云修士建造的长城上空。
一道玄衣苍发的身影，自天道洪流中缓缓踏出。
他身着与陈怀安形制相仿的玄衣，面容轮廓与其有七分相似，眉眼鼻梁如出一辙，可偏偏没有半分活人的气韵。
双目是纯粹的淡金色，空洞、漠然，不含一丝人性情绪，唯有俯瞰众生的冰冷神性。
周身缠绕着无数道凝如实质的法则链纹。
脚下沉浮着苍云界的山川河岳虚影。
他步步踏出，从容不迫，每上前一步，就有大片苍云法则随之扩散，将地星本土的天道一寸寸挤压吞噬。
“陈怀安？！”

元始天尊瞳孔骤缩，失声低喝。
他第一眼看去，几乎以为是封印中的人破封而出，绕到了界壁之外。
话音未落，他神念已然如闪电般扫向三十三重天外的紫霞秘境，牢牢锁定那团虚无晶壁。
下一瞬，他眉头皱得更紧。
紫霞秘境中的封印完好无损。
晶壁上的玉清、上清封印阵纹毫无松动。内里那道白衣身影依旧闭目垂落，气息沉寂，分明还被牢牢封在其中。
“不对……他还在秘境之中。”
“他不是陈怀安。”通天教主眯起眼，周身杀道气息微微绷紧，目光死死盯着那道玄衣持剑的身影:
“你仔细看他的气息，血肉神魂皆无，从头到脚都是纯粹的天道规则凝聚，这明显是苍云界的天道意志显化。”
他执掌截教万仙，阅尽洪荒生灵，从未见过哪尊修士能有如此厚重，如此浑然一体的世界道韵。
这不是修士修成的圣体。
而是一界天道亲自降下的化身。
元始天尊神色凝重，目光在苍云天道的面容上反复打量：“既是天道化身，为何样貌与陈怀安如此相像？”
巧合？
绝不可能！
圣人眼里从无巧合。
这般高度的相似，必然牵扯着更深的因果。
“谁知道。”通天教主指尖青萍剑微微震颤，诛仙四剑在身侧缓缓转动，眼底掠过一丝凝重，“斩了他，抽了他的天道本源，一问便知。”
话虽说得杀伐果断，他心底却隐隐升起一丝不安。
先是太上陨落，再是陈怀安以新晋圣人之姿横压天庭，如今连苍云天道都生得与他一般模样……此人的根脚，绝不止菩提转世那么简单。
content_en:
When Yuanshi and Tongtian turned into two streams of light and swept to the edge of the boundary wall.
It happened that Cangyun Tiandao completed the final blow.
boom--!
There was just a loud bang that resounded through the three realms, and the cracks in the boundary film that were still slowly spreading were instantly burst by an incomparable force.
The barrier between the two realms collapsed like broken glass.
The golden torrent of heaven pours in from the gap, pouring in like the Milky Way bursting its banks.
With the gap as the center, the law of heaven in the Cangyun Realm invaded the hinterland of the Earth Star at a speed visible to the naked eye. In just a few breaths, it had covered nearly half of the sky.
The stars in the sky shifted accordingly, and the three hundred and sixty-five main stars in the Earth Star's homeland were forcibly squeezed out of their orbit, and the dragon energy of the earth veins roared overwhelmingly.
The water of the four seas rolled back into the sky, and the mountains rose and collapsed one after another under the collision of laws.
The turmoil does not only occur near the passage of two worlds.
Because the rules of Earth, Star, Heaven and Earth are under attack.
Even if it is not the place where Cangyun Heavenly Dao comes, it will also be affected by the turmoil.
Above the Great Wall built by monk Cangyun.
A figure in black clothes and gray hair slowly stepped out of the torrent of heaven.
He was wearing a mysterious robe that was similar in appearance to Chen Huaian's, and his facial contours were 70% similar to his. His eyebrows, eyes, and bridge of nose were exactly the same, but he didn't have the charm of a living person.
The eyes are pure pale gold, empty and indifferent, without a trace of human emotion, only the cold divinity overlooking all living beings.
The whole body is wrapped with countless law chain patterns that are as solid as substance.
Underfoot are the shadows of the mountains and rivers of the Cangyun Realm.
He stepped forward step by step, calmly, and with every step he took, a large area of ​​Cang Yun Law spread out, squeezing and swallowing the Heavenly Dao of Earth Star inch by inch.
"Chen Huaian?!"
Yuanshi Tianzun's pupils shrank suddenly and he shouted in a low voice.
At first glance, he almost thought that the person in the seal broke out and went around outside the boundary wall.
Before he finished speaking, his spiritual thoughts swept towards the Zixia Secret Realm beyond the thirty-third heaven like lightning, firmly locking on the void crystal wall.
The next moment, he frowned even more tightly.
The seal in the Zixia Secret Realm is intact.
The seal formation patterns of Yuqing and Shangqing on the crystal wall are not loose at all. The white-clothed figure inside still closed his eyes and drooped, his breath was silent, and he was clearly still firmly sealed inside.
"No...he is still in the secret realm."
"He is not Chen Huaian." Leader Tongtian narrowed his eyes, his murderous aura tightened slightly, and his eyes were fixed on the figure in Xuanyi holding a sword:
"If you look carefully at his aura, there is no flesh, blood, soul, anything. From head to toe, he is pure and pure heavenly law. This is obviously the manifestation of the heavenly will of the Cangyun Realm."
He is in charge of intercepting and teaching thousands of immortals, and has read all the creatures in the ancient world. He has never seen any monk who can have such a thick and integrated world of Taoism.
This is not the Holy Body cultivated by monks.
It is the incarnation of a realm of heaven personally descended.
Yuanshi Tianzun looked solemn and looked at Cangyun Tiandao's face repeatedly: "Since he is the incarnation of Tiandao, why does he look so similar to Chen Huaian?"
Coincidence?
Absolutely impossible!
There are no coincidences in the eyes of a saint.
Such a high degree of similarity must involve deeper cause and effect.
"Who knows." The Green Ping Sword on Tongtian Cult Master's fingertips trembled slightly, and the Four Immortal Execution Swords were slowly turning at his side. There was a trace of solemnity in his eyes, "Behead him, take away his heavenly origin, and you will know as soon as you ask."
Although he spoke decisively, there was a hint of uneasiness in his heart.
First, the Supreme Emperor fell, and then Chen Huaian dominated the heavens as a newly promoted saint. Now even Cangyun Tiandao is born like him... This person's roots are by no means as simple as Bodhi's reincarnation.
